title: Setup installer
summary: One Inno Setup installer for the engine, chart scripts, Graphviz dot, the IDE plugin, ConvRulesEditor, drag-lint-graph and YADF
intro: `drag-lint-setup-<version>.exe` installs the whole tool set per user or for all users, registers the IDE plugins only where RAD Studio 13 is installed, and uninstalls only what it wrote.
